data.name: Vendor.Privacy.V1
data.value: WaslaBid, the platform that runs this portal, keeps your company's registration details, the documents you upload and a record of what you do here, so that the organizations you work with can assess your company and every decision can be audited. Your data is stored in Saudi Arabia. An organization sees your company only after you register or work with it through its portal. Your company decides, through its consent ledger, whether any other party may receive its records. You can ask for a copy of your data or for its correction at any time.

data.name: Console.Ownership.Disputes.Intro
data.value: Each request says that a company registered on WaslaBid belongs to someone else. A new request holds nothing until you accept it for review; from then on no organization can approve the company. Requests are grouped by company, oldest first. A request made while five older ones for the same company are still pending is marked, never refused, since the real owner may be among them. Contact the claimant, check the commercial registration certificate and any authorisation, then uphold or reject the request.
